ku.text: Write a complex number as $z=a+bi$ with $i^2=-1$.
The conjugate of $a+bi$ is $a-bi$, and $z\overline z=a^2+b^2$.
Plot $z$ at $(a,b)$ on an Argand diagram.

misc.weak: Changing the real part when finding the conjugate
misc.better: Keep the real part and reverse the sign of the imaginary part.

terms.text: Give a reason that connects the mathematical idea to the situation.
